name: code-mode-recipes
description: Provides tested JavaScript patterns for the sandbox: parallel fetches, custom indicators, backtests, watchlist scans, and compact summaries; load before writing any trading script.

name: debate-and-review
description: Runs bull, bear, and risk_reviewer subagents in parallel before entries and records the verdict; load before every new entry.

name: earnings-and-catalysts
description: Enforces the 5-day earnings blackout, trades post-earnings drift only on held gaps, and structures catalyst research; load before any entry and around reports.

name: etf-mean-reversion
description: Buys short-term washed-out dips in broad index ETFs trading above their 200-day with strict time stops; load only for oversold index ETFs, never single stocks.

name: fundamentals-check
description: Runs a 5-minute quality and trend veto from sec_company facts and recent filings; load to reject bad businesses before any entry, never to value them.

name: macro-calendar
description: Keeps FOMC, CPI, payrolls, and PCE event risk out of new entries by checking the calendar reference before trading; load each morning and before any entry.

name: market-reference
description: Covers settlement, trading rules, the NYSE calendar, data limits, and published LLM-trading findings; load when a rule, date, or tool limit is unclear.

name: market-regime
description: Classifies the market trend and volatility regime from SPY, QQQ, VIX, and yields; load at the start of every cycle to set exposure and allowed setups.

name: news-research
description: Grades sources by tier, reads filings before narratives, and cites evidence in journal format; load whenever a catalyst, headline, or Bull thesis needs verification.

name: portfolio-heat
description: Measures total open risk, correlation clusters, and sector exposure and forces reductions before limits bind; load when considering entries and during position reviews.

name: position-sizing-and-exits
description: Sizes positions from dollar risk and ATR stops and manages exits by R-multiples, trailing, and time stops; load for every order and every open position review.

name: pullback-in-uptrend
description: Buys pullbacks to the 20-day EMA or 50-day SMA in confirmed uptrends with RSI and depth filters; load when a leader has sold off toward support.

name: quant-toolkit
description: Evidence-first trading loop with the quant tools (screen, backtest, risk, size); load before picking entries, adding risk, or sizing orders.

name: relative-strength-rotation
description: Ranks sectors and leaders by 3- and 6-month relative strength against SPY with market_compare; load for weekly rotation and to confirm leaders.

name: reports
description: Publishes daily, weekly, and trade reports through publish_report after the close; load at each post-close review.

name: small-account
description: Sizes positions and plans the day for a small limited-margin account with fractional shares, swing holds, and buying-power discipline; load before sizing any trade or planning the day.

name: trade-review-and-calibration
description: Reviews closed trades on R-multiples, MFE/MAE, and Brier scores and writes lessons back to memory; load at each post-close review.

name: trend-breakout
description: Trades 20-day and 52-week high breakouts in leading stocks with volume confirmation and ATR stops; load when the regime allows breakouts.
